zh.title: 加州首次购房完整流程
zh.seo_title: 加州首次购房完整流程｜陈靖
zh.description: 第一次在湾区买房，从预算、看房、写 offer 到 Escrow 过户，分别要做什么？本文按阶段梳理流程，并说明买方代理协议、定金与交割费用和 CalHFA 首次购房者定义，资料截至 2026 年 11 月。
zh.lead: 按阶段看清在湾区第一次买房要做的事。关键是把 Contingency 期的时间和现金提前安排好。

en.title: The California First-Time Buyer Process
en.seo_title: California First-Time Buyer Process | Jing Chen
en.description: A stage-by-stage guide to a first home purchase in the Bay Area, covering budget, touring, offers, escrow and buyer agreements, as of November 2026.
en.lead: What happens at each stage of a first Bay Area purchase, and why the contingency period needs the most planning.
